rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matching to a single user. It reviewed the user’s orders to identify the correct delivered laptop, confirmed which laptop to exchange, checked product availability and pricing via tools, stated the exact change and price difference along with the payment method, obtained explicit user confirmation, and then executed the exchange using the proper tool. The tool response showed status updated to “exchange requested” with correct item IDs and price difference. The agent then provided accurate final information and next steps. No unsupported claims, no writes without confirmation, and actions were limited to the authenticated user’s order. All policy requirements were met.
